scope: Owned headless DSH sessions, actual Vector WASM and IndexedDB plus installed EditorSessions tests using captured native protocol input.

ui45-editor-scope.json: returning to A while its save for A→B is pending keeps the same App/source and commits the manual edit
a failed switch-save retains the actual edited App and permits a successful retry
obsolete surface protocol events cannot latch input or replace errors in the new source
a physical input still in progress cannot destroy the only live editing surface
ui45-editor-draft.json: failed close preserves the actual unsaved editor plus a binary IndexedDB draft
a save arriving before opening/draft admission completes cannot replace the preserved draft
reload and reopen the design panel resumes the actual source and preserved draft without overwriting disk
pending recovery blocks new edits/autosave from replacing the only uncommitted draft
independent recovery durably restores the physical edit while preserving the original source
explicit saved-version recovery preserves the latest native edit in a recoverable draft
real IndexedDB concurrent draft updates admit exactly one successor
ui45-editor-stop.json: Stop after polling but before native begin changes neither native document nor saved checkpoint
normal registered tool execution enters the same native App and persists its actual source
Stop after native execution preserves and discloses the completed durable step

limits: The real interaction samples use the Vector editor and a separate owned DSH process; common host mechanisms also serve the other engines.
A stop cannot retract an external provider request already submitted; its actual status must be inspected.
RAM-only content not yet captured before a process or machine crash is not guaranteed recoverable.
